fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can confirm the correct property from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective posts on both sides to define the entry point during low-light or smoke conditions.
• Keep the full width of the driveway clear of parked vehicles and equipment so fire apparatus and ambulances can reach the residence without stopping.
• Maintain overhead clearance along the driveway to allow ladder trucks and tall emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Identify and mark a turnaround area near the residence so apparatus can reverse direction without backing the full length of the driveway.
• Keep a secondary path across the open lawn area passable so responders have an alternate route to the residence if the driveway is blocked.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the driveway so responders on foot can move alongside apparatus without pushing through brush.
• Mark the water feature clearly along any path that leads toward it so responders moving quickly across the property at night can see the hazard.
• Install a physical barrier or reflective markers at the edge of the water feature nearest the driveway or staging area to prevent vehicle or personnel entry.
• Identify the water feature to your local fire department in advance as a potential drafting source, noting its location relative to the driveway.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Clear brush from both sides of the single access route to keep it open for vehicles.
• Trim tree branches that hang over or close to the driveway.
• Thin scattered trees nearest to the structure to increase open space around it.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or close to the structure.
• Cut back brush areas where they extend toward the structure or driveway.
• Mow or cut grass around the structure and outbuildings, especially where it grows tall and dense.
• Separate shrub clusters from nearby trees to reduce connected plant material between them.
• Keep the area between the water feature and the structure clear of tall grass and shrubs.
• Remove dead or dry grass and plant material from areas immediately surrounding the structure.
• Keep open terrain areas free of encroaching shrubs or tall grass growth.
